rawReport.retention: Generated reports are ignored locally; GitHub Actions saves each engine report and failure traces for 14 days.

regressionDetection.method: Removed address preservation in a separate throwaway copy; working tree source unchanged.
regressionDetection.test: addresses remain literal at every intermediate key after the first recognition cue

limitations: Keyboard actions use Playwright in headless desktop engine builds; this is not installed browser application or device certification.
Clipboard, composition, and input-without-beforeinput cases inject events; OS clipboard permissions and real IME/mobile keyboards are not covered.
No assistive technology, accessibility conformance, framework-controlled fields, or rich-text/contenteditable support is established.
Source hashes and the pinned dependency lockfile identify this run; later source/fixture changes require a separate record.
Test durations are diagnostics and are not a performance benchmark.
